page.overview:
Who is Suana Dragand?

Suana Dragand is an Aes Sedai, a former Sitter and the current head of the Yellow Ajah.

She described as "beefy" with "too much chin, a square stone of it". The Companion describes her as "A beefy woman, with too much chin, blue eyes, a square face and wide square hands"., Suana Dragand|comp}}

She has an unyielding demeanor.. Alviarin thinks she is arrogant and likely to take her own views as that of her whole Ajah. She has a blunt manner.

She is also politically well-connected and very knowledgeable - a woman with a will who could get things done..
